## Why visit

A small, quietly impressive survivor of Liverpool’s neighbourhood pub tradition. Two rooms and the intervening drinking lobby are connected by an elaborate glazed service screen; the etched glass is the reason to look carefully rather than simply note that the pub is old. The tiny scale and local clientele make this an appealing place for conversation after the Philharmonic’s visual extravagance. Include it for intimacy and surviving pub form, not for an expectation of a large beer festival on the bar.
